{{Quote|In that red, red field of Gorm, where he had been born, I lay my little binggy down to dieeee&hellip;|A song performed by a captured singer aboard the ''Bloodstar''|<ref name="BarKooda" />}}
'''Gorm''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]]. Located on the [[Galactic Frontier/Legends|Galactic Frontier]] by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] known as [[Gorm-worm/Legends|gorm-worms]], which were exported across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], an individual visited the ancient [[Gorm Academy]] in order to study its secrets.

==Description==
Gorm was a terrestrial<ref name="The Gorm Academy" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TotJC" /> located in the [[Gorm system/Legends|Gorm system]], a part of the [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]]<ref name="EAOC Gorm" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA Gorm" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Gorm" /> It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] known as [[Gorm-worm/Legends|gorm-worms]], which, despite being dangerous to capture, had become exported across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="TotJC" /> by [[3999 BBY]]<ref name="3999 BBY">{{InsiderCite|26|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth: A Guide to the ''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' Universe, Part 1}} dates the events of [[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]], which includes the appearance of a [[Skritch|gorm-worm]] aboard the [[Stenness Hyperspace Terminal]], to 3,999 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[3999 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> for their [[Death/Legends|lethal]] venom.<ref name="TotJC" />

==History==
Between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], Gorm constituted a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], it was located outside the "civilized [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]," or the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that had been widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Gorm had become a part of that territory by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA Gorm" /> by which [[Time/Legends|time]] it was situated on the [[Galactic Frontier/Legends|Galactic Frontier]].<ref name="TotJC" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
At some point long before<ref name="The Gorm Academy" /> [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date TOR">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Gorm Academy" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an [[Unidentified architect|architect]] designed an [[Gorm Academy|academy]] on Gorm in which they had many secrets hidden.<ref name="The Gorm Academy" /> Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date TOR" /> an individual dispatched a companion to study the academy, which the facility's caretakers allowed them to do in return for a donation.<ref name="The Gorm Academy" />
{{Endgame}}

When the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Bar-Kooda]] attacked a [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] with a group of entertainers aboard<ref name="BarKooda" /> at some point by [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]],<ref name="6 ABY">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: Bounty on Bar-Kooda]]'' to [[Standard decade/Legends|ten years]] after {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Furthermore, the flashback scene in ''Bounty on Bar-Kooda'' in which [[Bar-Kooda]] [[Death/Legends|kills]] the captured [[Unidentified singer|singer]] is set at least four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, and therefore at some point by [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].</ref> he made them all perform for him, shooting any whose performances he did not enjoy. At one point, a captured [[Unidentified singer|singer]] took the stage with a [[Music/Legends|song]] the lyrics of which told about a [[binggy]] which had been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in a "[[Color/Legends|red]], red field" on Gorm. In the song, the binggy was laid down to die in that same field, and the composition made Bar-Kooda sad, although he ultimately killed the [[Musician/Legends|singer]] anyway.<ref name="BarKooda" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorm was first mentioned in [[Boba Fett: Bounty on Bar-Kooda|''Bounty on Bar-Kooda'']],<ref name="BarKooda" /> the first entry in<ref name="FatLady">''[[Boba Fett: When the Fat Lady Swings]]''</ref> the [[Star Wars: Boba Fett (comic series)|''Star Wars: Boba Fett'']]<ref name="BarKoodaMarvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54025/star_wars_boba_fett_-_bounty_on_bar-kooda_1995_1|text=Star Wars: Boba Fett - Bounty On Bar-Kooda (1995) #1}}</ref> series of one-shot [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]].<ref name="ComicCareer">{{StoryCite|story=The Bounty Hunter's Comic Book Career|book=Star Wars: Boba Fett}}</ref> The issue was written by [[John Wagner]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="BarKooda" /> on [[December 5]], [[1995]].<ref name="BarKoodaMarvel" /> The [[1996]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' by [[George R. Strayton]] was the first source to establish that Gorm was a distinct astronomical object,<ref name="TotJC" /> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gorm [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA Gorm" />

In the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="SWTOR base game date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111213|text=EARLY GAME ACCESS FOR THE OLD REPUBLIC BEGINS TODAY}}</ref> players could assign their companions to visit Gorm as part of the Crew Skill mission "The Gorm Academy." However, the mission outcome text, which has since been removed from the game, instead mentioned them having visited the [[Telosian Jedi Academy|Telos Academy]],<ref name="The Gorm Academy" /> located on<ref name="CSWE Atris">{{CSWECite|I|47|Atris}}</ref> the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]]<ref name="EAOC Telos">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Telos system/Legends|Telos system]]</ref> planet [[Telos IV|Telos]].<ref name="CSWE Telos">{{CSWECite|III|229|Telos}}</ref>
